_note: Booklet A keys read off the scan by eye, for the two schools whose answers
were printed as a picture of a grid rather than as text. Committed because
work-ans/ is regenerated; the precedent is review/marks.json, which records
mark allocations no OCR pass can recover.
These are NOT a substitute for reading the page. build/prelim_key.py checks
every entry here against whatever OCR could establish from the same grid and
fails the extraction outright if the two disagree, so this file can fill gaps
but can never quietly overrule the scan. See CLAUDE.md section 1.6.1 for why
a wrong digit here is the worst failure in the project.
Red Swastika: OCR read 26 of its 28 cells unaided and agrees with every one
recorded here; only Q3 and Q7 needed a person. Nanyang: OCR agreed on the 19
questions numbered 10 and above, which is all its grid can be read for
without ambiguity, and the rest were read by eye.
